name: rpi-run-stats
descriptionZh: 在终端底部显示实时运行统计，可通过 /stats 或快捷键切换监控。
descriptionEn: Show live runtime statistics beneath the terminal footer, with command and shortcut controls.
description: Show live runtime statistics beneath the terminal footer, with command and shortcut controls.

name: rpi-mcp-adapter
descriptionZh: 通过 stdio 或 Streamable HTTP 连接 MCP 服务，调用工具并读取或订阅资源。
descriptionEn: Connect to MCP servers over stdio or Streamable HTTP to call tools and read or subscribe to resources.
description: Connect to MCP servers over stdio or Streamable HTTP to call tools and read or subscribe to resources.

name: rpi-mcp-server
descriptionZh: 将 rpi 作为 MCP 服务供其他客户端调用，支持 stdio 和 Streamable HTTP。
descriptionEn: Expose rpi to MCP clients as a server over stdio or Streamable HTTP.
description: Expose rpi to MCP clients as a server over stdio or Streamable HTTP.

name: rpi-subagents
descriptionZh: 将有界任务委派给宿主管理的子代理，接收进度和结构化执行报告。
descriptionEn: Delegate bounded tasks to host-managed subagents and receive progress updates and structured execution reports.
description: Delegate bounded tasks to host-managed subagents and receive progress updates and structured execution reports.

name: rpi-codemode
descriptionZh: 使用有界原生 JavaScript 程序调用当前可用工具，组合多步工具操作。
descriptionEn: Run bounded native JavaScript programs against the tools active in the current invocation.
description: Run bounded native JavaScript programs against the tools active in the current invocation.

name: rpi-orchestrator
descriptionZh: 使用会话内的有界任务图规划和调度子代理进程，汇总任务执行结果。
descriptionEn: Plan and dispatch bounded subagent processes through a session-scoped task graph and collect their results.
description: Plan and dispatch bounded subagent processes through a session-scoped task graph and collect their results.

name: rpi-btw
descriptionZh: 通过 /btw 进行独立的只读旁路问答，支持连续追问，不打断或写入主会话。
descriptionEn: Ask read-only side questions with /btw and follow up without interrupting or adding to the main conversation.
description: Ask read-only side questions with /btw and follow up without interrupting or adding to the main conversation.

name: rpi-lens
descriptionZh: 运行预设的差异、Cargo 编译、格式或 Clippy 检查，返回有界代码诊断。
descriptionEn: Run allowlisted diff, Cargo check, formatting or Clippy checks and return bounded code diagnostics.
description: Run allowlisted diff, Cargo check, formatting or Clippy checks and return bounded code diagnostics.

name: rpi-todo
descriptionZh: 管理当前会话的任务清单，跟踪待办、进行中和完成状态。
descriptionEn: Manage the current session task list and track pending, in-progress and completed work.
description: Manage the current session task list and track pending, in-progress and completed work.

name: rpi-goal
descriptionZh: 为会话设定持续目标，在每轮结束后继续推进，直到完成、受阻、等待或达到限制。
descriptionEn: Keep pursuing a session objective across settled runs until completion, a blocker, a wait or a safety limit.
description: Keep pursuing a session objective across settled runs until completion, a blocker, a wait or a safety limit.

name: rpi-optchat
descriptionZh: 持久记录会话，将历史整理为有界摘要，并通过 zoom 和 search 工具检索回忆。
descriptionEn: Keep persistent conversation memory with bounded summaries and zoom/search tools for recalling history.
description: Keep persistent conversation memory with bounded summaries and zoom/search tools for recalling history.

name: rpi-plan-mode
descriptionZh: 进入只读规划模式，探索需求并提交可供审核的实施计划，不自动执行变更。
descriptionEn: Explore requirements in read-only planning mode and submit an implementation plan for review without executing changes.
description: Explore requirements in read-only planning mode and submit an implementation plan for review without executing changes.

name: rpi-codegraph
descriptionZh: 通过本地 CodeGraph CLI 建立和同步索引，查询代码符号、调用关系与依赖影响。
descriptionEn: Index and sync a project through the local CodeGraph CLI to query symbols, call relationships and dependency impact.
description: Index and sync a project through the local CodeGraph CLI to query symbols, call relationships and dependency impact.

name: rpi-ask-user
descriptionZh: 通过交互式输入、选项或确认对话框向用户提问，获取明确的结构化答复。
descriptionEn: Ask interactive questions using text input, choices or confirmation dialogs and receive structured answers.
description: Ask interactive questions using text input, choices or confirmation dialogs and receive structured answers.

name: rpi-permissions
descriptionZh: 保存并查询工具调用的允许和拒绝规则，由宿主挂钩负责执行权限策略。
descriptionEn: Store and inspect tool allow/deny rules for enforcement through the host permission hook.
description: Store and inspect tool allow/deny rules for enforcement through the host permission hook.

name: rpi-websearch
descriptionZh: 无需 API key，通过公开网页参考源和 GitHub 搜索接口查找资料，返回有界结果。
descriptionEn: Look up public web references and GitHub results without an API key, with bounded responses.
description: Look up public web references and GitHub results without an API key, with bounded responses.

name: rpi-webfetch
descriptionZh: 无需 API key，获取公开 HTTP(S) 页面中的有界文本，不执行 JavaScript。
descriptionEn: Fetch bounded text from public HTTP(S) pages without an API key or JavaScript execution.
description: Fetch bounded text from public HTTP(S) pages without an API key or JavaScript execution.

name: rpi-im-message
descriptionZh: 通过飞书或 Lark 长连接接收消息，并发送文本、Markdown 和交互卡片。
descriptionEn: Receive Feishu/Lark messages over a persistent connection and send text, Markdown and interactive cards.
description: Receive Feishu/Lark messages over a persistent connection and send text, Markdown and interactive cards.

name: rpi-office
descriptionZh: 通过 pi-for-office 任务窗格加载项读写已打开的 Excel、Word 和 PowerPoint 文档。
descriptionEn: Read and edit open Excel, Word and PowerPoint documents through the pi-for-office task-pane add-in.
description: Read and edit open Excel, Word and PowerPoint documents through the pi-for-office task-pane add-in.

name: rpi-langfuse
descriptionZh: 将代理运行追踪上报到 Langfuse，并提供追踪查询、评分和提示词管理工具。
descriptionEn: Report agent traces to Langfuse and provide tools for trace queries, scoring and prompt management.
description: Report agent traces to Langfuse and provide tools for trace queries, scoring and prompt management.

name: rpi-voice
descriptionZh: 通过语音输入和按键说话与 rpi 对话，并可选择开启助手回复朗读。
descriptionEn: Talk to rpi with voice input and push-to-talk, with optional spoken assistant replies.
description: Talk to rpi with voice input and push-to-talk, with optional spoken assistant replies.

name: rpi-acp
descriptionZh: 通过 ACP 将 rpi 接入 Zed 等客户端，支持流式回复、工具交互和会话管理。
descriptionEn: Use rpi in Zed and other ACP clients, with streamed replies, tool interactions and session management.
description: Use rpi in Zed and other ACP clients, with streamed replies, tool interactions and session management.

name: rpi-permission-gate
descriptionZh: 在 bash、write 和 edit 等潜在危险操作前请求用户确认，拒绝时阻止调用。
descriptionEn: Request user confirmation before potentially dangerous bash, write and edit operations, blocking declined calls.
description: Request user confirmation before potentially dangerous bash, write and edit operations, blocking declined calls.
tool: --permission-gate (confirm bash/write/edit via the host UI dialog)

name: rpi-ui-adapter
descriptionZh: 通过 ACP 将 rpi 接入现有 Web 界面，首个适配器支持 Open WebUI。
descriptionEn: Connect rpi to existing web interfaces through ACP, starting with an Open WebUI adapter.
description: Connect rpi to existing web interfaces through ACP, starting with an Open WebUI adapter.
inspiredBy: Open WebUI Pipe / Agent Client Protocol

name: rpi-providers
descriptionZh: 在一个扩展中集成 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、llama.cpp、Proxy、Antigravity 和 OpenAI Codex 提供方。
descriptionEn: Integrate DeepSeek, OpenRouter, llama.cpp, Proxy, Antigravity and OpenAI Codex providers in one extension.
description: Integrate DeepSeek, OpenRouter, llama.cpp, Proxy, Antigravity and OpenAI Codex providers in one extension.

name: rpi-web
descriptionZh: 在浏览器中管理项目和会话，查看流式对话、工具交互、文件预览与 Git 差异。
descriptionEn: Manage projects and sessions in a browser with streamed conversations, tool interactions, file previews and Git diffs.
description: Manage projects and sessions in a browser with streamed conversations, tool interactions, file previews and Git diffs.

name: rpi-edit-diagnostics
descriptionZh: 使用精确文本匹配编辑文件，在匹配失败时提供可复制的编译器式差异诊断。
descriptionEn: Edit files with exact text matching and copyable, compiler-style diagnostics when a match fails.
description: Edit files with exact text matching and copyable, compiler-style diagnostics when a match fails.

name: rpi-http
descriptionZh: 通过原生扩展或独立服务提供 HTTP/SSE API，复用共享运行时且不附带前端界面。
descriptionEn: Serve the shared runtime through an HTTP/SSE API using a native extension or standalone service, without a frontend.
description: Serve the shared runtime through an HTTP/SSE API using a native extension or standalone service, without a frontend.
inspiredBy: API-only HTTP/SSE service over the shared rpi core
